description:
Prerequisite for the spine deletion fz-go4.18.4 (Decision 2, option C: port-first). Migrate the transport-contract test coverage off the legacy world.transport_plan / DeriveTransportPlan onto the PRODUCT TransportPlan flow, so the spine deletion becomes a clean no-coverage-loss commit.

SCOPE
- src/compiler2/transport_contract_test.rs (~4944 lines, ~64 tests) — drive the legacy DeriveTransportPlan via drive_until_transport_plan and assert world.transport_plan(root) shape/lane/boundary/callable contracts.
- src/compiler2/semantic_analysis_test.rs (~18 legacy refs, uses transport_plan_for_runtime_demands_for_test).
- src/compiler2/drive_test.rs (~43 refs touching the legacy plan).

METHOD — intent-by-intent (this is the heart of the ticket)
For EACH test that references world.transport_plan / DeriveTransportPlan / drive_until_transport_plan / transport_plan_for_runtime_demands_for_test:
1. State the test's INTENT in one line (the contract it actually protects — e.g. 'enum_reduce operator refs resolve to direct arity-2 callable transport with no boundary', 'tuple return lanes are int', 'shape constraint solve is insertion-order independent').
2. Decide KEEP or DROP:
   - DROP only if the intent is (a) already covered by an existing product-path test (the .18.x work added compiler2_pull_transport_* and others — cross-check), or (b) purely asserting a legacy job NAME / legacy-store mechanism with no product-flow analog. Justify every drop with the covering test or the reason.
   - KEEP if it protects a real transport contract not otherwise covered.
3. For KEEP: retarget it to the PRODUCT flow — drive the product backend (run_root_interp / build_backend_product / the product driver) and assert the SAME contract against the product TransportPlan (session_transport_plan / the BackendProgram's transport inventory). Add a product accessor if needed (must be a real production-shaped read, not a test-only shim — per the 'tests use production paths' rule).

GOAL / SIGNAL
- rg over tests shows ZERO references to world.transport_plan / define_transport_plan / DeriveTransportPlan / drive_until_transport_plan / transport_plan_for_runtime_demands_for_test (everything ported or dropped-with-justification).
- The transport contracts (shape/lane/boundary/callable resolution, insertion-order independence, the enum_reduce operator-ref direct-callable contract, etc.) are asserted against the PRODUCT TransportPlan and pass.
- lib green across >=3 fresh runs; clippy -D warnings = 0; fmt clean.
- A short KEEP/DROP ledger (intent + disposition + covering test for drops) in the commit body / ticket.

GUARDRAILS
No test-only shims/mocks — thread the real product state the way production does. Do not weaken assertions (port the contract faithfully). Do not delete real coverage without a named covering test. No legacy spine revival. Blocks fz-go4.18.4 (after this, deleting world.transport_plan/DeriveTransportPlan is clean).
title: Port transport-contract tests to the product TransportPlan flow (intent-by-intent, keep/drop ledger)
